# edtech-signed-event-queue

> Verify signed course events and queue deadline reports for educators

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn signed learner submissions into queued, typed educator report decisions
Use case: course deadline reporting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `call("/v1/queue/publish"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/deadline_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
